contexts.text: With the Angels there is a flaming beam in the midst, from the good of celestial and spiritual love...
This beam of light... is called glory...
Divine Truth... can never appear in the very radiance in which it is...
This (human form) appeared in a flaming beam...
I afterwards saw that this flaming beam descended...
I once also (saw the Lord) in the midst of the Angels as a flaming beam.
As when a sun-beam is cut off by the interposition of a black cloud.
After His Advent, the Lord appears as a Sun with stronger radiance, and in greater resplendence... DLW 233:2.
The intervening space sparkled with a radiance of light...
It intensifies this colour as it were into a flaming beam.
There suddenly appeared a beam of light... TCR 625.
I saw the rising Sun in its radiance...
The Sun of the Spiritual World appeared to me in its radiance...
From the radiance round about (the Word there) appear as it were most lovely rainbows.
